evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout on 41fa111, completed successfully; contract 109 applied. Corroborated read-only: the ledger holds 109 rows through 20260805050000. All three new functions are deployed BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed migration — next_eligible_league_round md5 83eb5286ba0ba1cd1287ddbdb829ebd1 over 844 characters, generate_lms_successor_windows md5 48477a28108e05f02ea9481b778a768b over 5578, process_due_lms_restarts md5 8f1f7c53c67ed12d1ce286cddd792b68 over 2540. Every one is granted to none of anon, authenticated, service_role or PUBLIC, including the public job, which is reachable only by the scheduler. The pg_cron entry season-restart-due-lms-competitions exists at 15 * * * *, fifteen minutes after the settlement job whose report it reads. The job is behaviour-neutral on development today: zero season_lms_settled audit rows, zero league matchweeks, zero season fixtures and zero successors, so its own selection finds nothing to act on.
